translation: 안내를 받지 않고 인슐린 용량을 바꾸지 마세요.

english: Do not stop long-term steroids suddenly without medical advice.
transliteration: ui-ryo-jin-gwa sang-ui-ha-ji an-ko jang-gi-gan bok-yong-han seu-te-ro-i-deu-reul gap-ja-gi kkeun-ji ma-SE-yo.
translation: 의료진과 상의하지 않고 장기간 복용한 스테로이드를 갑자기 끊지 마세요.

english: We can arrange a visit with a diabetes educator.
transliteration: DANG-nyo-byeong gyu-yuk dam-dang-ja-wa-ui jin-ryo-reul ye-yak-hae deu-ril su i-sseo-yo.
translation: 당뇨병 교육 담당자와의 진료를 예약해 드릴 수 있어요.

english: Please bring your medicines and glucose readings next time.
transliteration: da-eum-e o-shil ttae bok-yong jung-in ya-gwa hyeol-dang su-chi-reul ga-jyeo-wa ju-SE-yo.
translation: 다음에 오실 때 복용 중인 약과 혈당 수치를 가져와 주세요.

english: We will discuss a plan that works for you.
Are you very drowsy or confused?
Are you vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
Do you have severe weakness or fainting?
transliteration: shim-ha-ge gi-un-i eop-geo-na sseu-reo-ji-shin jeo-gi it-na-yo?
translation: 심하게 기운이 없거나 쓰러지신 적이 있나요?

english: Seek urgent medical help if you become confused or faint.
translation: 혼란스러워지거나 쓰러지면 즉시 의료진의 도움을 받으세요.

english: When is your next follow-up appointment?
Do you have any questions about the plan?
What would you like help with today?
How have you been feeling lately?
Is it okay if I ask some personal questions?
transliteration: gae-in-jeok-in jil-mun-eul myeot ga-ji deu-ryeo-do gwaen-chan-eul-kka-yo?
translation: 개인적인 질문을 몇 가지 드려도 괜찮을까요?

english: You can tell me if a question feels uncomfortable.
transliteration: bul-pyeon-ha-ge neu-kki-neun jil-mun-i i-sseu-myeon mal-sseum-ha-syeo-do dwae-yo.
translation: 불편하게 느껴지는 질문이 있으면 말씀하셔도 돼요.

english: I will listen without judging you.
Would you prefer to speak with an interpreter?
I will explain the limits of confidentiality.
transliteration: bi-mil bo-jang-i je-han-doe-neun gyeong-u-reul seol-myeong-hae deu-ril-kke-yo.
translation: 비밀 보장이 제한되는 경우를 설명해 드릴게요.

english: Is there anything important you want me to know?
transliteration: je-ga a-ra-ya hal jung-yo-han jeom-i it-na-yo?
translation: 제가 알아야 할 중요한 점이 있나요?

english: When did these feelings or symptoms begin?
Did anything happen around the time they started?
transliteration: jeung-sang-i shi-jak-doel jeu-eum-e mu-seun i-ri i-sseot-na-yo?
translation: 증상이 시작될 즈음에 무슨 일이 있었나요?

english: Have things been getting better or worse?
transliteration: sang-tae-ga na-a-ji-go it-na-yo, a-ni-myeon na-ppa-ji-go it-na-yo?
translation: 상태가 나아지고 있나요, 아니면 나빠지고 있나요?

english: How often do you feel this way?
How much is this affecting your daily life?
transliteration: i i-ri il-sang-saeng-hwal-e eol-ma-na yeong-hyang-eul ju-go it-na-yo?

english: Are you able to go to work or school?
Are you managing your usual responsibilities?
What has helped you cope so far?

english: Do unwanted thoughts keep coming into your mind?

Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic or excited?

translation: 평소와 다르게 에너지가 넘치거나 들뜨는 때가 있었나요?

translation: 피곤하지 않은데도 잠을 훨씬 적게 자도 괜찮았던 적이 있나요?

english: Have others said you were talking unusually fast?
transliteration: da-reun sa-ram-deul-i pyeong-so-bo-da ma-reul hweol-ssin ppa-reu-ge han-da-go han jeo-gi i-sseu-na-yo?

english: Have your thoughts been racing?
transliteration: saeng-gak-i kko-ri-e kko-ri-reul mul-go ppa-reu-ge i-eo-jyeot-na-yo?
translation: 생각이 꼬리에 꼬리를 물고 빠르게 이어졌나요?

english: Have you felt unusually confident or powerful?
transliteration: pyeong-so-bo-da ja-shin-gam-i neom-chi-geo-na keun him-i it-da-go neu-kki-syeo-sseo-yo?

english: Have you spent more money than you intended?
transliteration: saeng-gak-haet-deon geo-bot-da don-eul deo ma-ni sseu-syeo-sseo-yo?
translation: 생각했던 것보다 돈을 더 많이 쓰셨나요?

english: Have you taken unusual risks during these periods?
transliteration: geu-reon shi-gi-e pyeong-so-wa da-reun wi-heom-han haeng-dong-eul ha-shin jeo-gi it-na-yo?
translation: 그런 시기에 평소와 다른 위험한 행동을 하신 적이 있나요?

english: How long did these periods last?
Have you heard voices that others cannot hear?

english: Have you seen things that others cannot see?

translation: 다른 사람은 보지 못하는 것을 보신 적이 있나요?

english: Do you feel that someone is watching or following you?
Do you feel that someone wants to harm you?
Do you feel your thoughts are being controlled?

translation: 그 목소리가 어떤 행동을 하라고 시킬 때도 있나요?

english: What do you think these experiences mean?

english: Have you wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?

english: Have you ever hurt yourself on purpose?

translation: 일부러 자신을 다치게 한 적이 있나요?

translation: 지금까지 안전하게 지내는 데 무엇이 도움이 됐나요?

english: Is there someone you trust whom we can contact?
transliteration: jeo-hui-ga yeon-rak-hae-do gwaen-cha-neun, mi-deul su it-neun bun-i gye-shin-ga-yo?
translation: 저희가 연락해도 괜찮은, 믿을 수 있는 분이 계신가요?

english: I am concerned about your safety and want to help you stay safe.
transliteration: hwan-ja-bun-e an-jeon-i geok-jeong-dwae-seo an-jeon-ha-ge ji-na-shil su it-do-rok do-u-go shi-peo-yo.
translation: 환자분의 안전이 걱정돼서 안전하게 지내실 수 있도록 돕고 싶어요.

english: Do you feel safe where you live?
Has anyone threatened or hurt you?

translation: 누군가 위협하거나 다치게 한 적이 있나요?

english: Are you afraid of anyone at home?

translation: 집에 있는 사람 중 두려운 사람이 있나요?

english: Have you had thoughts of hurting someone else?
transliteration: da-reun sa-ram-eul hae-chi-go shi-tta-neun saeng-gak-eul ha-shin jeo-gi it-na-yo?
translation: 다른 사람을 해치고 싶다는 생각을 하신 적이 있나요?

english: Is there a particular person you are thinking about hurting?

Are there children or other vulnerable people at home?

english: Have you experienced something frightening or traumatic?

translation: 두렵거나 충격적인 일을 겪으신 적이 있나요?

english: You do not have to share details before you are ready.
transliteration: jun-bi-ga dwae-gi jeon-e-neun ja-se-hi mal-sseum-ha-ji an-eu-syeo-do dwae-yo.

english: Do memories of that experience come back unexpectedly?
Do you have nightmares about what happened?

english: Do you avoid reminders of what happened?

english: Do you feel constantly on guard or unsafe?

Do you worry a lot about your weight or body shape?

Do you sometimes feel unable to stop eating?

Do you take sleeping pills or benzodiazepines?
What dose do you take and how often?
transliteration: han beo-ne EOL-ma-na deu-shi-go, EOL-ma-na ja-ju deu-SE-yo?
translation: 한 번에 얼마나 드시고, 얼마나 자주 드세요?

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: i ya-geul deu-shin ji EOL-ma-na doe-syeo-sseo-yo?
translation: 이 약을 드신 지 얼마나 되셨어요?

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
Has the medicine been helping?
Have you noticed any side effects?
Have you stopped any medication recently?
What are your goals for treatment?
transliteration: chi-ryo-reul tong-hae eo-tteon mok-pyo-reul i-ru-go shi-peu-SE-yo?
translation: 치료를 통해 어떤 목표를 이루고 싶으세요?

english: Would you be interested in talking therapy or counselling?
We can discuss medication options together.
transliteration: yak-mul chi-ryo seon-taek-ji-reul ham-kke sang-ui-hal su i-SSE-yo.
translation: 약물 치료 선택지를 함께 상의할 수 있어요.

english: Some medicines take several weeks to work fully.
transliteration: ya-ge tta-ra hyo-gwa-ga chung-bun-hi na-ta-na-gi-kka-ji myeot ju-ga geol-lil su i-SSE-yo.
translation: 약에 따라 효과가 충분히 나타나기까지 몇 주가 걸릴 수 있어요.

english: Please speak with your clinician before stopping medication.
transliteration: ya-geul kkeun-gi jeo-ne dam-dang ui-ryo-jin-gwa kkok sang-ui-hae ju-SE-yo.
translation: 약을 끊기 전에 담당 의료진과 꼭 상의해 주세요.

english: Would you like us to involve a trusted family member?
transliteration: mi-deul su in-neun ga-jok-bun-eul ham-kke cham-yeo-shi-ki-go shi-peu-SE-yo?
translation: 믿을 수 있는 가족분을 함께 참여시키고 싶으세요?

english: We can make a plan for what to do if symptoms worsen.
transliteration: jeung-sang-i shim-hae-jil ttae eo-tteo-ke hal-ji ham-kke gye-hoeg-eul se-ul su i-SSE-yo.
translation: 증상이 심해질 때 어떻게 할지 함께 계획을 세울 수 있어요.

english: What concerns do you have about treatment?
Do you feel safe going home today?
Who could you call if you felt unsafe?
transliteration: an-jeon-ha-ji an-tta-go neu-kki-shi-myeon nu-gu-e-ge jeon-hwa-ha-shil su in-na-yo?
translation: 안전하지 않다고 느끼시면 누구에게 전화하실 수 있나요?

english: Can we identify warning signs that things are getting worse?
transliteration: sang-tae-ga na-ppa-ji-go it-tta-neun shin-ho-reul ham-kke hwa-gin-hae bol-kka-yo?
translation: 상태가 나빠지고 있다는 신호를 함께 확인해 볼까요?

english: If you are in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
transliteration: ji-geum dang-jang wi-heom-han sang-hwang-i-ra-myeon eung-geup do-um-eul ba-deu-SE-yo.
translation: 지금 당장 위험한 상황이라면 응급 도움을 받으세요.

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: chu-hu jin-ryo ye-yak-eul ja-ba-deu-ril su i-SSE-yo.
translation: 추후 진료 예약을 잡아드릴 수 있어요.

english: Would you like information about local support services?
transliteration: ji-yeok-e ji-won seo-bi-seu-e gwan-han jeong-bo-reul ba-da-bo-shi-ge-sseo-yo?
translation: 지역의 지원 서비스에 관한 정보를 받아보시겠어요?

english: Is there anything else you would like to ask?
I am going to ask some questions about your symptoms.
transliteration: jeung-sang-e dae-hae myeot ga-ji jil-mun-eul deu-ril-kke-yo.
translation: 증상에 대해 몇 가지 질문을 드릴게요.

english: When did your symptoms first begin?
Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: jeung-sang-i gap-ja-gi shi-jak-dwaen-na-yo, a-ni-myeon seo-seo-hi shi-jak-dwaen-na-yo?
translation: 증상이 갑자기 시작됐나요, 아니면 서서히 시작됐나요?

english: What were you doing when this started?
transliteration: jeung-sang-i shi-jak-dwae-sseul ttae mu-eo-seul ha-go gye-syeo-sseo-yo?
translation: 증상이 시작됐을 때 무엇을 하고 계셨어요?

english: Are the symptoms constant or do they come and go?
transliteration: jeung-sang-i gye-sok in-na-yo, a-ni-myeon saeng-gyeot-tta sa-ra-jyeot-tta ha-na-yo?
translation: 증상이 계속 있나요, 아니면 생겼다 사라졌다 하나요?

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: han-beon jeung-sang-i saeng-gi-myeon EOL-ma-na o-rae ji-sok-doe-na-yo?
translation: 한 번 증상이 생기면 얼마나 오래 지속되나요?

english: How many times a day or week does this happen?
transliteration: ha-ru-na iL-ju-i-le myeot beon i-reon i-ri saeng-gi-na-yo?
translation: 하루나 일주일에 몇 번 이런 일이 생기나요?

english: Are your symptoms getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: jeung-sang-i na-a-ji-go in-na-yo, shim-hae-ji-go in-na-yo, a-ni-myeon geu-dae-ro-in-ga-yo?
translation: 증상이 나아지고 있나요, 심해지고 있나요, 아니면 그대로인가요?

english: Have you ever had this problem before?
transliteration: jeo-ne i-reon mun-je-ga i-sseot-deon jeo-gi i-SSEU-se-yo?
translation: 전에 이런 문제가 있었던 적이 있으세요?

english: Does anything make it better or worse?
transliteration: jeung-sang-eul nat-ge ha-geo-na deo shim-ha-ge ha-neun geo-shi in-na-yo?
translation: 증상을 낫게 하거나 더 심하게 하는 것이 있나요?

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel unwell during the examination.
transliteration: geom-sa jung-e mo-mi an jo-eu-myeon ba-ro mal-sseum-hae ju-SE-yo.
translation: 검사 중에 몸이 안 좋으면 바로 말씀해 주세요.

english: Did you suddenly develop weakness on one side of your body?
Did one side of your face suddenly droop?
Did you suddenly have trouble speaking?
Did you suddenly have trouble understanding speech?
Did you suddenly lose vision in one or both eyes?
transliteration: han-jjok nun-i-na yang-jjok nu-ne shi-ryeo-geul gap-ja-gi i-reu-syeot-na-yo?
translation: 한쪽 눈이나 양쪽 눈의 시력을 갑자기 잃으셨나요?

english: Did you suddenly lose your balance or coordination?
transliteration: gap-ja-gi gyun-hyeong-eul jap-geo-na dong-ja-geul jo-jeol-ha-gi eo-ryeo-wo-ji-syeot-na-yo?
translation: 갑자기 균형을 잡거나 동작을 조절하기 어려워지셨나요?

english: What time were you last completely well?
Did the symptoms go away completely?
Did you have the worst headache of your life?
Did the headache reach maximum intensity within seconds or a minute?
transliteration: du-tong-i myeot cho-na iL-bun a-ne ga-jang shim-hae-jyeot-na-yo?
translation: 두통이 몇 초나 1분 안에 가장 심해졌나요?

english: Do you have a fever with a stiff neck?
Have you had a new seizure or lost consciousness?
transliteration: sae-ro bal-ja-geul ha-geo-na ui-shi-geul i-reu-shin jeo-gi in-na-yo?
translation: 새로 발작을 하거나 의식을 잃으신 적이 있나요?

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
Do you have numbness around your groin or buttocks?
transliteration: sa-ta-gu-ni-na eong-deong-i ju-byeo-ni jeo-ri-geo-na gam-ga-gi eop-na-yo?
translation: 사타구니나 엉덩이 주변이 저리거나 감각이 없나요?

english: Where exactly is your headache?
Is the pain on one side or both sides of your head?
transliteration: meo-ri han-jjok-i a-peu-na-yo, yang-jjok-i da a-peu-na-yo?
translation: 머리 한쪽이 아픈가요, 양쪽이 다 아픈가요?

english: Does the pain spread to your neck, face, or behind your eyes?
transliteration: tong-jeung-i mo-gi-na eol-gul, tto-neun nun dwi-jjo-geu-ro peo-ji-na-yo?
translation: 통증이 목이나 얼굴, 또는 눈 뒤쪽으로 퍼지나요?

english: Is the pain throbbing, pressing, stabbing, or burning?
transliteration: tong-jeung-i uk-shin-geo-ri-na-yo, nu-reu-neun deu-ta-na-yo, jji-reu-neun deu-ta-na-yo, a-ni-myeon hwa-kkeun-geo-ri-na-yo?
translation: 통증이 욱신거리나요, 누르는 듯한가요, 찌르는 듯한가요, 아니면 화끈거리나요?

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: tong-jeung-i yeong-jeom-e-seo shi-bbeom-jung myeot-jjeom jeong-do-ro shim-han-ga-yo?
translation: 통증이 0점에서 10점 중 몇 점 정도로 심한가요?

english: Does light or noise bother you during the headache?
transliteration: du-tong-i i-sseul ttae bit-i-na so-ri-ga bul-pyeon-ha-ge neu-kki-na-yo?
translation: 두통이 있을 때 빛이나 소리가 불편하게 느껴지나요?

english: Do you feel nauseated or vomit with the headache?
Do you see flashing lights or zigzag lines before the headache?
transliteration: du-tong-i o-gi jeo-ne beon-jjeo-gi-neun bit-i-na ji-geu-ja-geu seon-i bo-i-na-yo?
translation: 두통이 오기 전에 번쩍이는 빛이나 지그재그 선이 보이나요?

english: Does physical activity make the headache worse?
Does coughing, straining, or bending make it worse?
transliteration: gi-chim-ha-geo-na hi-meul ju-geo-na mo-meul su-gi-myeon deo shim-hae-ji-na-yo?
translation: 기침하거나 힘을 주거나 몸을 숙이면 더 심해지나요?

english: Is the headache worse when lying down or standing up?
transliteration: nu-wo it-geo-na i-reo-seol ttae du-tong-i deo shim-hae-ji-na-yo?
translation: 누워 있거나 일어설 때 두통이 더 심해지나요?

english: Does the headache wake you from sleep?
Have your headaches changed recently?
How many days each month do you have a headache?
transliteration: han da-re myeot chi jeong-do du-tong-i in-na-yo?
translation: 한 달에 며칠 정도 두통이 있나요?

english: How often do you take painkillers for headaches?
transliteration: du-tong ttae-mu-ne jin-tong-je-reul EOL-ma-na ja-ju deu-shi-na-yo?
translation: 두통 때문에 진통제를 얼마나 자주 드시나요?

english: Do you feel the room spinning or do you feel faint?
transliteration: ba-ngi bing-bing do-neun geo gat-na-yo, a-ni-myeon sseu-reo-jil geo gat-na-yo?
translation: 방이 빙빙 도는 것 같나요, 아니면 쓰러질 것 같나요?

english: Do you feel unsteady when walking?
Does turning your head trigger the dizziness?
Does standing up trigger the dizziness?
Does the dizziness last seconds, minutes, hours, or longer?
transliteration: eo-ji-reom-jeung-i myeot cho, myeot bun, myeot shi-gan tto-neun geu i-sang ji-sok-doe-na-yo?
translation: 어지럼증이 몇 초, 몇 분, 몇 시간 또는 그 이상 지속되나요?

english: Do you have ringing in your ears or hearing loss?
transliteration: gwi-e-seo ul-li-neun so-ri-ga na-geo-na cheong-nyeo-gi tteo-reo-jyeot-na-yo?
translation: 귀에서 울리는 소리가 나거나 청력이 떨어졌나요?

english: Have you fallen because of the dizziness?
Can you walk without assistance?
Do you feel weakness in your arms or legs?
Is one side weaker than the other?
Do you have trouble lifting your arms above your head?
transliteration: pa-reul meo-ri wi-ro deu-reo ol-li-gi eo-ryeop-na-yo?
translation: 팔을 머리 위로 들어 올리기 어렵나요?

english: Do you have trouble standing up from a chair?
Do you trip because your foot drags?
Do you drop objects from your hands?
Does the weakness get worse with repeated activity?
transliteration: ga-teun dong-ja-geul ban-bok-ha-myeon hi-mi deo ppa-ji-na-yo?
translation: 같은 동작을 반복하면 힘이 더 빠지나요?

english: Does resting improve the weakness?
Have you noticed muscle twitching or cramps?
transliteration: geun-yu-gi shil-luk-geo-ri-geo-na jwi-ga nan jeo-gi in-na-yo?
translation: 근육이 씰룩거리거나 쥐가 난 적이 있나요?

english: Have your muscles become smaller over time?
Do you have numbness or tingling anywhere?
transliteration: mom eo-di-e jeo-ri-geo-na jji-rit-han neu-kki-mi in-na-yo?
translation: 몸 어디에 저리거나 찌릿한 느낌이 있나요?

english: Where does the numbness begin and where does it spread?
transliteration: jeo-rin neu-kki-mi eo-di-seo shi-jak-hae eo-di-kka-ji peo-ji-na-yo?
translation: 저린 느낌이 어디서 시작해서 어디까지 퍼지나요?

english: Is the numbness in both hands or both feet?
Do you feel burning or electric-shock-like pain?
transliteration: ta-neun deu-ta-geo-na jeon-gi chung-gyeok ga-teun tong-jeung-i in-na-yo?
translation: 타는 듯하거나 전기 충격 같은 통증이 있나요?

english: Does the pain travel from your back down your leg?
Can you feel hot and cold normally?
transliteration: tteu-geo-un geo-shwa cha-ga-un geo-seul bo-tong-cheo-reom neu-kki-na-yo?
translation: 뜨거운 것과 차가운 것을 보통처럼 느끼나요?

english: Does touching the skin cause unusual pain?
transliteration: pi-bu-reul man-ji-myeon pyeong-so-wa da-reun tong-jeung-i in-na-yo?
translation: 피부를 만지면 평소와 다른 통증이 있나요?

english: Have you ever had a seizure or fit?
Did anyone see what happened during the episode?
transliteration: geu-ttae i-sseot-deon i-reul bon sa-ram-i in-na-yo?
translation: 그때 있었던 일을 본 사람이 있나요?

english: Did your arms or legs shake uncontrollably?
Did you lose awareness of your surroundings?
Did you bite your tongue?
Did you lose control of your bladder?
Were you confused or sleepy afterward?
Did you notice a strange smell, feeling, or warning before the episode?
transliteration: geu i-ri i-reo-na-gi jeo-ne i-sang-han naem-sae-na neu-kki-mi deul-geo-na, mi-ri al-li-neun shin-ho-ga i-sseot-na-yo?
translation: 그 일이 일어나기 전에 이상한 냄새나 느낌이 들거나, 미리 알리는 신호가 있었나요?

english: How long did it take to return to normal?
transliteration: pyeong-so sang-tae-ro do-ra-o-neun de EOL-ma-na geol-lyeot-na-yo?
translation: 평소 상태로 돌아오는 데 얼마나 걸렸나요?

english: Have you missed any doses of your seizure medicine?
Do your hands shake when resting or when using them?
transliteration: so-neul ga-man-hi du-go i-sseul ttae-na sa-yong-hal ttae so-ni tteol-li-na-yo?
translation: 손을 가만히 두고 있을 때나 사용할 때 손이 떨리나요?

english: Does the shaking affect one hand or both?
transliteration: tteol-li-mi han-jjok so-ne-man in-na-yo, yang-so-ne in-na-yo?
translation: 떨림이 한쪽 손에만 있나요, 양손에 있나요?

english: Has your handwriting become smaller?
Do you feel stiff or move more slowly?
Have you had difficulty starting to walk?
Do you freeze or feel stuck while walking?
transliteration: geot-tta-ga mo-mi gu-teo-geo-na ba-ri tteo-reo-ji-ji an-neun neu-kki-mi deu-na-yo?
translation: 걷다가 몸이 굳거나 발이 떨어지지 않는 느낌이 드나요?

english: Have you noticed changes in your voice or facial expression?
Have you been forgetting recent conversations or appointments?
Do you have trouble finding the right words?
Have you become lost in familiar places?
transliteration: ik-suk-han go-seo gil-eul i-reun jeo-gi in-na-yo?
translation: 익숙한 곳에서 길을 잃은 적이 있나요?

english: Do you have difficulty managing medicines or finances?
Have you noticed changes in your mood or behaviour?
Do you have trouble concentrating?
Has your speech become slurred?
Do you have trouble swallowing food or liquids?
Do you see double?
Does the double vision go away when you cover one eye?
transliteration: han-jjok nu-neul ga-ri-myeon mul-che-ga du gae-ro bo-i-neun jeung-sang-i sa-ra-ji-na-yo?
translation: 한쪽 눈을 가리면 물체가 두 개로 보이는 증상이 사라지나요?

english: Have you noticed a drooping eyelid?
Do you have numbness or pain in your face?
Have you noticed weakness on one side of your face?
transliteration: eol-gul han-jjok-e hi-mi ppa-jin geo-seul a-ra-cha-ryeo-na-yo?
translation: 얼굴 한쪽에 힘이 빠진 것을 알아차렸나요?

english: Have you noticed changes in your hearing?
Do you choke or cough when swallowing?
Have you ever had a stroke or a mini-stroke?
transliteration: noe-jol-jung-i-na il-gwa-seong noe-heo-hyeol bal-ja-geul gyeo-reun jeo-gi in-na-yo?
translation: 뇌졸중이나 일과성 뇌허혈 발작을 겪은 적이 있나요?

english: Have you ever had a head injury or concussion?
transliteration: meo-ri-reul da-chi-geo-na noe-jin-tang-eul gyeo-reun jeo-gi in-na-yo?
translation: 머리를 다치거나 뇌진탕을 겪은 적이 있나요?

english: Have you ever had meningitis or a brain infection?
transliteration: noe-su-mak-yeom-i-na noe gam-yeom-eul gyeo-reun jeo-gi in-na-yo?
translation: 뇌수막염이나 뇌 감염을 겪은 적이 있나요?

english: Do you have diabetes, high blood pressure, or high cholesterol?
transliteration: dang-nyo-byeong, go-hyeo-ap tto-neun kol-le-seu-te-rol su-chi-ga no-peun-ga-yo?
translation: 당뇨병, 고혈압 또는 콜레스테롤 수치가 높은가요?

english: Does anyone in your family have migraines, seizures, or a neurological condition?
transliteration: ga-jok jung-e pyeon-du-tong, bal-jak tto-neun shin-gyeong-gye jil-hwa-ni in-neun sa-ram-i in-na-yo?
translation: 가족 중에 편두통, 발작 또는 신경계 질환이 있는 사람이 있나요?

english: What medicines do you take regularly?
What is the name and dose of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: bok-yong-ha-shi-neun bal-jak ya-geu-rui i-reum-gwa yong-ryang-i eo-tteo-ke doe-na-yo?
translation: 복용하시는 발작 약의 이름과 용량이 어떻게 되나요?

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: i ya-geul bok-yong-ha-shin ji EOL-ma-na dwaen-na-yo?
translation: 이 약을 복용하신 지 얼마나 됐나요?

english: Have you recently started, stopped, or changed a medicine?
transliteration: choe-geun-e ya-geul sae-ro shi-jak-ha-geo-na kkeun-eo-geo-na ba-kkwon-na-yo?
translation: 최근에 약을 새로 시작하거나 끊거나 바꿨나요?

english: Has this medicine helped your symptoms?
Have you noticed any side effects?
Do you drink alcohol or use recreational drugs?
transliteration: SOOL-eul ma-shi-geo-na gi-bun jeon-hwan-yong yak-mu-reul sa-yong-ha-shi-na-yo?
translation: 술을 마시거나 기분 전환용 약물을 사용하시나요?

english: Can you tell me your full name?
Can you tell me today's date?
Can you tell me where we are right now?
Please repeat these three words after me.
transliteration: je-ga maL-ha-neun se dan-eo-reul tta-ra mal-sseum-hae ju-SE-yo.
translation: 제가 말하는 세 단어를 따라 말씀해 주세요.

english: Please remember these words; I will ask you again later.
transliteration: i dan-eo-deu-reul gi-eo-kae du-SE-yo. na-jung-e da-shi yeo-jjwo-bol-kke-yo.
translation: 이 단어들을 기억해 두세요. 나중에 다시 여쭤볼게요.

transliteration: su-sul mal-go da-reun bang-beo-bi i-sseul su-do i-sseo-yo.
translation: 수술 말고 다른 방법이 있을 수도 있어요.

english: Do you have any questions about the operation?
You may need general anesthesia, which makes you unconscious during surgery.
transliteration: su-sul jung-e ui-si-gi eop-do-rok ha-neun jeon-sin-ma-chwi-ga pi-ryo-hal su-do i-sseo-yo.
translation: 수술 중에 의식이 없도록 하는 전신마취가 필요할 수도 있어요.

english: Local anesthesia numbs only the area being treated.
transliteration: guk-so-ma-chwi-neun chi-ryo-ha-neun bu-wi-man gam-ga-gi eop-ge hae-yo.
translation: 국소마취는 치료하는 부위만 감각이 없게 해요.

english: We may need to make a small cut in the skin.
transliteration: pi-bu-reul jo-geum jeol-gae-hae-ya hal su-do i-sseo-yo.
translation: 피부를 조금 절개해야 할 수도 있어요.

english: We may need to place a drain to remove fluid.
transliteration: che-ae-geul ppae-nae-gi wi-hae bae-aek-gwa-neul neo-eo-ya hal su-do i-sseo-yo.
translation: 체액을 빼내기 위해 배액관을 넣어야 할 수도 있어요.

english: We may need to close the wound with stitches.
When did you last eat or drink anything?
Please do not eat or drink until the team tells you it is safe.
transliteration: ui-ryo-jin-i gwaen-chan-ta-go hal ttae-kka-ji meok-geo-na ma-si-ji ma-se-yo.
translation: 의료진이 괜찮다고 할 때까지 먹거나 마시지 마세요.

english: Have you spoken with the anesthesiologist?
Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
We will check your blood pressure and pulse.
We may give you fluids through a vein.
I am going to check your wound.
Is the wound more painful than before?
Have you noticed redness or swelling around the wound?
Is any pus coming from the wound?
We will change the dressing.
Please keep the dressing clean and dry.
We will remove the stitches when the wound has healed enough.
Is the drain collecting fluid?
How is your pain since the operation?
Have you been able to eat or drink?
Have you felt nauseated or vomited?
Have you passed gas since surgery?
Have you passed stool since surgery?
Have you been able to get out of bed and walk?
Have you had any trouble passing urine?
Please ask for help before getting up if you feel dizzy.
transliteration: eo-ji-reo-u-myeon i-reo-na-gi jeo-ne do-u-meul yo-cheong-hae ju-se-yo.
translation: 어지러우면 일어나기 전에 도움을 요청해 주세요.

english: Do you have severe or worsening abdominal pain?
transliteration: bae-ga sim-ha-ge a-peu-geo-na tong-jeung-i deo si-meo-ji-go in-na-yo?
translation: 배가 심하게 아프거나 통증이 더 심해지고 있나요?

english: Have you been vomiting repeatedly?
Are you unable to pass gas or stool?
Do you have a fever or chills?
Is the wound bleeding heavily?
Do you have chest pain or trouble breathing?
Have you fainted or felt very dizzy?
If these symptoms occur, seek emergency medical care.
transliteration: i-reon jeung-sang-i na-ta-na-myeon eung-geup jin-ryo-reul ba-deu-se-yo.
translation: 이런 증상이 나타나면 응급 진료를 받으세요.

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment with the surgical team.
We may refer you to a cancer specialist.
Please come back if the wound becomes red, swollen, or painful.
transliteration: sang-cheo-ga ppal-ga-ji-geo-na bu-eo-geo-na a-peu-myeon da-si o-se-yo.
translation: 상처가 빨개지거나 붓거나 아프면 다시 오세요.

english: Do you have any questions?
Can you explain how you will care for the wound at home?
transliteration: ji-be-seo sang-cheo-reul eo-tteo-ke gwan-ri-ha-sil-ji seol-myeong-hae ju-sil su in-na-yo?
translation: 집에서 상처를 어떻게 관리하실지 설명해 주실 수 있나요?

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
